# Database query (`source_type: database`)

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-probe-refs.ts from packages/probe-config. Do not edit by hand. -->

Runs one read-only query against Postgres, MySQL, Redis or MongoDB and reports the single number it returns.

- Runs on: an Observer Agent (set the metric's `agent` to its name)
- Thresholds: required when the metric is created (all four fields)
- testProbe: supported

## Value and unit

- no unit: scalar returned by the read-only query (one row, one column), as returned by the query; Observer does not rescale it

## source_config fields

| Field | Required | Type | Default | Limits |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | yes | enum |  | `postgres`, `mysql`, `redis`, `mongodb` |
| `connection_string_ref` | yes | string |  | env var name on the agent host (UPPER_SNAKE_CASE) |
| `query` | yes | string |  | up to 8192 characters |
| `statement_timeout_ms` | no | integer | `5000` | 100 to 30000 |

## Rules

- `connection_string_ref` is the name of an env var on the agent host holding the full connection URL. The URL never reaches Observer. Use a read-only database user.
- postgres and mysql: one SELECT (or WITH ... SELECT) statement returning one row with one column. No semicolons, no writes.
- redis: one read-only command from this list: DBSIZE, EXISTS, LLEN, SCARD, ZCARD, HLEN, STRLEN, TTL, PTTL, BITCOUNT, GET.
- mongodb: a JSON spec using `countDocuments` or `estimatedDocumentCount`, for example `{"db":"shop","collection":"orders","op":"countDocuments","filter":{"status":"pending"}}`. `$where`, `$function`, `$accumulator` and `$expr` are rejected.

## Example

```yaml
source_type: database
source_config: {"kind":"postgres","connection_string_ref":"OBSERVER_PG_DSN","query":"SELECT count(*) FROM jobs WHERE state = 'failed' AND created_at > now() - interval '15 minutes'"}
```
